efe7d2f7351d22d406e3117d510c62b8f556ed34.summary: A first-person write-up by an individual author describing how they opened a password-protected archive that holds leaked source code of the Conti ransomware group. The method is a known-plaintext attack using a public tool. The text lists three archive file names and mentions a VirusTotal check. The article was published in March 2022.
